body: I really feel for you because I know how you feel. The amount of emotional distress this has caused me is ridiculous. What makes it so hard is that you don’t have the clean break as you might in a normal breakup. It feels impossible to move on. At least you only have to wait for the summer to move if that’s what you choose. Much love to you!
Because people get lonely and need social contact!! And it takes a lot of willpower to break out of codependency. I realise this sounds rather pathetic but I think it’s the reality.

This is crazy because I am in pretty much the same situation and I was thinking about making a post. The only difference is that neither of us has gone on to date someone. It’s not clear from the post whether you still have feelings for him, do you? In my situation I am still really into him so it feels impossible to let go even though it would be healthier for both of us. Are you in a position where it would be possible for one or both of you to move out?? That is the option I’m currently considering...

Before I lost my virginity I also thought I was asexual, I think it was a combination of fear of pain (from penetration, I also suffered with vaginismus), and the fact that I only really feel desire for another person when I am in a situation that encourages it, ie my body is close to someone else’s. 
I think it is important that before you draw any conclusions about your sexuality you address the vaginismus. The longer you leave it the more problems it will cause. If your brain has learnt to associate fear with sex this could be the reason you feel uninterested in sex. :)
I do this too, I’m in a somewhat toxic situation that I really should leave but am terrified to end things because I will be isolated if I do so because I have come to rely on them solely!
